presentationBanner.title: Brazil at the heart of Toulouse
presentationBanner.description: Come discover our unique flavors and warm atmosphere

text.title: Bossa Nova, a Brazilian vibe in the city center of Toulouse

content.0: Our cuisine is inspired by Brazilian traditions, rich in multiple influences: African, Indigenous, European... Each dish tells a piece of this mixed, generous and flavorful story.
content.1: The atmosphere, on the other hand, is inspired by botecos, those small popular bars in Brazil where you share a drink, some petiscos, a good caipirinha and a good time.

content.0: At Bossa Nova, music is part of the soul of the place.
content.1: From time to time, we organize live concerts to make the room vibrate to the rhythm of Brazil.
content.2: To know when the next concert will take place, be sure to follow us on social media.

presentationBanner.title: Discover our menu
presentationBanner.description: Authentic Brazilian dishes prepared with passion

description.0: Our menu consists of permanent dishes, but also of ephemeral suggestions that vary according to the season and arrivals. To discover these products of the moment, we invite you to check out our posts and our permanent stories on Instagram.
description.1: Here you will find the complete menu with all our fixed dishes.
description.2: In case of allergies, please let us know when you make your reservation.

presentationBanner.title: Book your table
presentationBanner.description: We look forward to welcoming you to Bossa Nova!

content.0: You can book a table with our Google Maps booking space.
Do you want to experience a typical Brazilian night?
content.1: Be that a birthday, a team dinner or simply a good occasion to celebrate, we propose you to privatize our restaurant for a warming, lively and 100% Brazilian moment.

presentationBanner.title: About Us
presentationBanner.description: Discover the history and philosophy of Bossa Nova

textParagraphs.0: Bossa Nova is above all a love story: that of a Franco-Brazilian couple, and that of a colorful country, Brazil.
textParagraphs.1: Always driven by the love of its culture, its generous dishes and its catchy music, we wanted to open a place that resembles us.
textParagraphs.3: Here, cuisine, music and sharing come together to create a unique experience.

privacyPolicy.0: Privacy policy and personal data protection chart
privacyPolicy.2: Welcome to the website of Bossa Nova, a limited liability company (SARL) registered under SIRET number 94060380600016, located at 1 bis Rue de May, 31000 Toulouse, France. We are committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of our users. This policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our website, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacyPolicy.4: The data controller is the SARL Bossa Nova, whose registered office is located at 1 bis Rue de May, 31000 Toulouse, France. For any questions regarding your personal data, you can contact us by email at bossanovatoulouse@gmail.com or by phone at +33 05 67 68 64 79.
privacyPolicy.7:
• Contact information: If you contact us via the contact form or by email, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and the content of your message.
  • Navigation data: Technical information (IP address, browser type, pages visited, visit duration) via cookies, subject to your consent.
  • Location data: If you accept the display of the embedded Google Maps map on our site.
privacyPolicy.9: Our website uses cookies and third-party technologies (Google Maps, Instagram) to enhance your experience. You can accept or refuse these cookies at any time by clicking on the “Cookies Settings” link in the footer. If you refuse the use of third-party cookies, content from external sites (such as maps or social media posts) will not be displayed.
privacyPolicy.11: Reservations are managed through the reservation system integrated with Google Maps. The information you provide (name, surname, phone number, email, date and time of reservation) is processed directly by Google, in accordance with their privacy policy.
privacyPolicy.13: Your data is used for the following purposes:
privacyPolicy.14:

  • To improve our website and services;
  • To display personalized content (if you accept third-party cookies);
  • To comply with our legal obligations.
privacyPolicy.16: We do not sell or rent your personal data. Your information may be shared with:

privacyPolicy.19:
We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against loss, alteration, or unauthorized access.

Our website is hosted in servers from Vercel company, which applies high security standards.
